risks.title: Adjacency-index miss if a new edge kind were added
risks.mitigation: v1 adds NO kinds - metadata-only tagging; stitching is query-time

risks.title: Stale sibling graph yields stale cross-repo impact

decision_records.decision: kind:'external' + metadata tagging, NOT a new ImportResolutionKind or edge kind (v1)

decision_records.decision: cross-repo traversal is QUERY-TIME stitching, never persisted edges
decision_records.rationale: same persisted-fact vs projection split as the GX-005 governed_by/violates ruling; sibling graphs age independently
